title: Feast

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Feasts are large meals that last longer and can be shared among several people.
Feasts are crafted at the Food preparation table and require spices bought from The Bog Witch.
Before being eaten, they must be placed using the Serving tray. They can be placed on any surface, on the floor or on a table, this is done using the Serving tray build menu to choose which feast to place. Once placed, the feast has 10 servings. When all servings are eaten, the empty platter must be removed using the Serving tray's "Remove" function.
If a feast has already been partially eaten, it yields nothing when destroyed or dismantled.

They can be placed on any surface, on the floor or on a table, this is done using the Serving tray build menu to choose which feast to place. Once placed, the feast has 10 servings. Trivia. • The visual appearance of the feast changes according to the number of remaining portions, those being six, three and zero.
